meta.author: claude
meta.description: Stone wall gate, level 1 of 3: shell and fittings (what soldiers build first). Over budget: 151 blocks vs 60. Its wall line is z 0..2 like the others, the towers also reach z 3. Two small crenellated towers and an arched opening 3 wide (no fence gate); the walk crosses over it and through the towers.
meta.changes: Quality check round 1: the merlon pattern changed across the whole set so modules tile end to end (a cobblestone-slab half merlon at x 0, merlons at x 2 and 4: neighbours now alternate high / low instead of two merlons side by side). The open notches at the front corners (arrow slits) are filled. The towers end in chequered stone merlons 2 above the wall merlons instead of flat spruce stair caps. A stone lintel at y 5 over the L3 portcullis bars. More detail from L1: a battered foot and a corbel course on the towers in line with the parapet corbels, the arch's front ring, lanterns in the arch; a watch lantern on each tower top from L2.
